Book a demo The Exigence power team of AI agents automating and guiding before, during, and after an incident Drill scenarios Tabletop copilot IR plan transformation Update generation IR plan onboarding Similar incident insights Summaries and reports Full control over AI generated reporting Exigence enables incident commanders to customize the AI prompts that govern how incident updates, summaries, and reports are generated. With full control over structure, contents, and tone, they ensure alignment with the organization’s reporting requirements, documentation standards, and compliance needs. AI-driven automation across the incident lifecycle AI Plan Transformer from document to platform-based Automatically modernizes legacy Word, PDF, presentation, or spreadsheet plans, transforming unstructured documents into fully digitized, platform-based IR workflows. [ before an incident ] AI Scenario Generator from document to platform-based Enables real-world incident simulation scenarios to be created in seconds. Users can select from pre-built scenarios by incident type or quickly generate customized scenarios tailored to their organization. [ before an incident ] AI Tabletop Copilot guiding incident response drills Guides enterprise teams during tabletop exercises and supports MSPs when running simulations with clients, providing real-time on-screen instructions that are aligned with the organization’s IR plan, roles, and workflows. [ during an incident ] AI Update Agent creating incident status updates Automatically generates clear status updates for incident commanders, responders, and stakeholders. Updates include key details such as what occurred, actions underway, and expected timelines, and can be shared as-is or tailored to specific needs. [ during an incident ] AI Similar Incident Agent insights from similar past incidents Automatically identifies similar past incidents, surfacing data relevant to the current incident’s scope, category, and impact. It enables teams to improve decision-making and accelerate resolution by applying insights from prior experience. [ after an incident ] AI Reporting Agent Creating incident summaries and RCA reports Eliminates the time-intensive, cumbersome task of creating incident summaries, root cause analyses (RCA), and post-incident reports. It automatically aggregates relevant incident and drill data into clear, insight-rich, and audit-ready reports, accelerating lessons learned and ensuring continuous improvement. For MSPs: AI Onboarding Agent client IR plan onboarding Automates the manual process of onboarding new clients to their incident response plans. The agent engages clients through natural language interactions via email, automatically performing key setup tasks such as collecting IR plan data, including user lists, role assignments, and more.
